capabilities: Sync Outlook mail folders to one note per email with frontmatter and thread indexes
Sync calendar events to notes plus an upcoming-meetings sidebar pane
Sync Teams chats and channel messages as running transcript notes
Perform incremental syncs using Microsoft Graph delta queries
Cross-link meeting notes to related emails by attendees and subject
extras: Desktop-only (not for Obsidian mobile). Setup details live in a separate SETUP.md. Refresh token is stored in plain text in the vault's data.json, and Teams channel scopes typically require admin consent.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull email, meetings, or Teams conversations into the vault as searchable notes.

relations.evidence: Sync your Microsoft 365 into your Obsidian vault — mail, calendar, and Teams messages

requires.name: Azure AD app registration (Microsoft 365 / Outlook / Teams)

summary: Microsoft 365 integration that syncs Outlook mail, calendar events, and Teams chats/channels into Markdown notes with incremental delta sync.
